about: AzuriteCon is a celebration of anime, gaming, comics and creativity. Join fellow fans for a weekend of independent makers, alternative Japanese fashion, panels, performances, cosplay and community in the heart of Newtown.

schedule.title: How to Start Your Art Journey

faqs: AzuriteCon will be held at 1 Bedford St, Newtown NSW 2042.
When does online ticket sales end?
Online Eventbrite sales end Thursday, 15 April 2027.
Can I buy tickets on the day?
Market Entry is $11 on the day. The $15 Saturday Market + Panels & Performances ticket is online sales only. Kids aged 12 years or under are $4 on the day.
How do I apply for Artist Alley?
Use the Artist Alley application link on this website. Application dates, table packages and requirements can be added here when confirmed.
How do I get to the venue?
The venue is at 1 Bedford St in Newtown, close to Newtown Station and King Street. Add your final transport and parking information before publishing.
Where can I find bump-in details?
Artist bump-in times, loading instructions, parking and pack-down information will be published here for accepted artists.
